Cinga ukuba sele ufundile iyunithi yepholinomiyali yeMathematika eQhelekileyo yesikolo samabanga aphezulu (imisebenzi emine yeepholinomiyali, ubunjalo bokwahlula, nokuhlela).
z-m-22-13.prereq.1: Ukufumana ixabiso lentetho ngokufaka inani kwipolynomial
z-m-22-13.topic: Amakoyefishenti e-polynomial namaxabiso xa kufakwa amanani
z-m-22-13.goal: Hlela ukuba ziziphi ubudlelwane phakathi kwamakoyefishenti onokuzazi nezo ungenakuzazi ngamaxabiso afunyenwe ngokufaka amanani, yenza amabinzana akho anelisa ubudlelwane, uze uchaze isizathu ngamagama alula.
z-m-22-13.material: Ukuba wandisa f(x)=(2x−1)⁵, amagama ukusuka kwi-x⁵ ukuya kwigama eliqhubekayo ayavela. Biza ikoyefishenti yegama ngalinye c5, c4, c3, c2, c1, c0 (c5 yikoyefishenti ye-x⁵ kwaye c0 ligama eliqhubekayo). Kulo msebenzi, ngaphandle kokwandisa, sicinga ukuba yintoni esinokuyazi nento esingenakuyazi kumaxabiso afunyenwe ngokufaka kuphela i-0, 1, −1 kwi-x. (2x−1)⁵ ifundwa ngokuthi "2x ukususa 1, kumandla amahlanu".
z-m-22-13.s.s1.prompt: Cinga ukuba wandise f(x)=(2x−1)⁵ wabhala f(x)=c5x⁵+c4x⁴+c3x³+c2x²+c1x+c0. Khetha zonke izinto onokuzifumana usebenzisa kuphela amaxabiso afunyenwe ngokufaka i-0, 1, −1 kwi-x ngaphandle kokwandisa.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala indlela ifom eyandisiweyo ye-f(x) ibe lula ngayo xa ufaka x=0, 1, −1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ngawaphi amagama anyamalalayo xa uphawu okanye ukususa iziphumo ze-x=1 ne-x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.a: Ubonile ukuba xa ufaka x=1, wonke amandla e-x kwigama ngalinye aba yi-1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.b: Ngamaxabiso amathathu 0, 1, −1, awunakwahlula enye kumakoyefishenti ayi-6. Bala ukuba zingaphi ii-equation onokuzifumana.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.o.c: Isixa samakoyefishenti amagama ebanga elingumangqabangqaba c5+c3+c1
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.c: Ubonile ukuba xa ususa amaxabiso kwi-x=1 nakwi-x=−1, amagama ebanga eliyipheyiri ayanyamalala.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.d: Udibanise inyaniso yokuba iimpawu zamakoyifishenti e-(2x−1)⁵ ziyatshintshana nexabiso kwi-x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.e: Awukwazi ukufumana c4 ngokwahlukeneyo usuka kumaxabiso ambalwa afakwe endaweni ye-x. Thelekisa inani lee-equation ozifumanayo nenani lee-unknown.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.explain: Kwi-x=1, f(1)=c5+…+c0=(2−1)⁵=1, kwaye kwi-x=−1, f(−1)=−c5+c4−c3+c2−c1+c0=(−3)⁵=−243. Isixa samakoyifishenti edigri engalinganiyo yi-(f(1)−f(−1))/2=122. Amakoyifishenti atshintshana ngophawu (32, −80, 80, −40, 10, −1), ngoko isixa samaxabiso apheleleyo yi-|f(−1)|=243. c3 okanye c4 azinakufumaneka ngamnye.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.acc.0: a no-c zikhethwe ngokuchanekileyo. d idinga ukuba uyazi nokuba iimpawu zamakoyifishenti ziyatshintshana, ngoko idinga ingcinga enye ngakumbi.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.prompt: Kwintetho yekhyubhiki f(x)=x³+ax²+bx+c, yenza iintetho ezintathu ezahlukileyo apho isixa sonke samakoyifishenti singu-0 kwaye isixa samakoyifishenti amagama edigri engalinganiyo (x³, x) singu-0 nasi.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isixa sonke samakoyifishenti nesixa samakoyifishenti amagama edigri engalinganiyo ngamnye njenge-equation ngo-a, b, c.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha unobumba olunye kuqala uze ufumane abanye.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Isixa samakoyifishenti amagama edigri engalinganiyo singu-0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Isixa 1+b samakoyifishenti amagama edigri engalinganiyo (x³, x) asingo-0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.explain: b=−1 kunye ne-c=−a. Imizekelo: ukuba a=0, x³−x; ukuba a=1, x³+x²−x−1; ukuba a=2, x³+2x²−x−2. Ezi ntetho zinayo f(1)=0 kunye ne-f(−1)=0, ngoko zonke zinayo (x−1)(x+1) njengento ehlelayo, kwaye x³+ax²−x−a=(x−1)(x+1)(x+a).
z-m-22-13.s.s3.prompt: Umntakwenu osebanjini lesi-3 lesikolo samabanga aphakathi ubuza, "Awuyandisanga i-(2x−1)⁵, ngoko uwazi njani isixa samakoyifishenti?" Cacisa ukuze umntakwenu aqonde.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba x⁵, x⁴, ..., x nganye iba yintoni xa ufaka u-1 endaweni ye-x.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ngamagama omntakwenu ukuba intetho eyandisiweyo ne-(2x−1)⁵ yintetho efanayo.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba ufaka u-1 endaweni ye-x, ...
z-m-22-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba xa ufaka u-1 endaweni ye-x, onke amandla aba ngu-1 kwaye amakoyifishenti kuphela asalayo?
z-m-22-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ukuba intetho eyandisiweyo neyingandisiwe yintetho efanayo, ngoko ukufaka kuyiphi na kunika ixabiso elifanayo?
z-m-22-13.s.s3.model.0: Kwifom eyandisiweyo ye-(2x−1)⁵, ukuba ufaka u-1 endaweni ye-x, i-x iyanyamalala kwaye isixa samakoyifishenti kuphela siyasala. Ngoko isixa samakoyifishenti yi-(2×1−1)⁵=1.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba ufaka x=1, onke amandla e-1 ayi-1, ngoko ikoyifishenti kuphela iyasala kwigama ngalinye. Intetho eyandisiweyo neyingandisiwe yintetho efanayo, ngoko ndifaka kwelula, i-(2x−1)⁵, ndifumane u-1.

z-m-22-01.title: Yintoni esalayo xa x ukuya kwi-2026 ihlulwa ngo-x²−1?
z-m-22-01.goal: Usebenzisa amaxabiso enza umahluli abe ngu-0, qinisekisa ukuba kutheni umthetho wentsalela oqikelelwe kwimizekelo embalwa usebenza nakumandla amakhulu, uze uwusebenzise xa wahlula ngenye intetho yekhwadratiki.
z-m-22-01.material: Xa x^n (intetho eneex ziphindaphindwe n amaxesha, n linani lemvelo) ihlulwa yintetho yekhwadratiki x²−1, inokubhalwa njenge-x^n=(x²−1)Q(x)+R(x), kwaye intsalela R(x) yintetho yedigri ye-1 ubuninzi (kubandakanywa iikhonstanti). Ukujonga iziphumo zika-n = 1, 2, 3, ... omnye ngomnye, masicinge ngentsalela xa n=2026. "x ukuya kwi-2026" yintetho enex ephindaphindwe amaxesha angama-2026.

z-m-22-01.thinking.2: Ukufumana isizathu nokwenza ngokubanzi kwezinye iimeko

z-m-22-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala iintsalela kwitheyibhile macala ngamacala nokuba n ilinganayo okanye ayilinganiyo.

Isiphumo sokwahlula ngqo (kubhalwe intsalela kuphela)
n=1: x¹ = (x²−1)·0 + x → intsalela x
n=2: x² = (x²−1)·1 + 1 → intsalela 1
n=3: x³ = (x²−1)·x + x → intsalela x

z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Zombini ingqikelelo "1 ukuba ilinganayo, x ukuba ayilinganiyo" nesigwebo sokufuna ukubona imizekelo emininzi zifanelekile ngoku. Kodwa imizekelo emithathu isisiseko sengqikelelo nje, hayi ubungqina.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqikelela umthetho wokuba x no-1 ziyatshintshana, x kwi-n engalinganiyo kunye no-1 kwi-n elinganayo.

z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uyazi ukuba zimithathu kuphela imizekelo kwaye uyalibazisa isigwebo.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kwiintsalela zemigca emithathu, awuyiboni ikoyifishenti ikhula. Wenze umthetho owahlukileyo kwisimo osibonileyo.

Yonke imizekelo emihlanu ihambelana ne-"x ukuba ayilinganiyo, 1 ukuba ilinganayo".

z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukuba yi-x+1, thelekisa ukuba a+b yintoni ne-1=a+b.

z-m-22-12.title: x⁴−4 kufuneka yahlulwe kude kangakanani phambi kokuba igqitywe?
z-m-22-12.topic: Ukwenza iifaktha (ukwenza iifaktha ngokupheleleyo kuxhomekeke kuluhlu lwamakoyefishenti)
z-m-22-12.goal: Qonda ukuba isigqibo sokuba ukwenza iifaktha "kugqityiwe" sixhomekeke kuluhlu lwamakoyefishenti, uze unqume indlela yokubhala impendulo xa akukho luhlu lunikiweyo.
z-m-22-12.material: Kukho izisombululo ezintathu ze-x⁴−4. Isisombululo ①: (x²−2)(x²+2), Isisombululo ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), Isisombululo ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Zontathu izisombululo zinika i-x⁴−4 xa zandisiwe. Ekwenzeni iifaktha, ibinzana elithi "alihluli ngakumbi" lixhomekeke ekubeni ngawaphi amanani avumelekileyo njengamakoyefishenti.
z-m-22-12.prereq.2: Intsingiselo esisiseko yamanani apheleleyo (iyunithi engeyonyani i, i²=−1)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.prompt: Kukho izisombululo ezintathu ezenza iifaktha ze-x⁴−4. Isisombululo ①: (x²−2)(x²+2). Isisombululo ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2). Isisombululo ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Khetha zonke izibhengezo ezichanekileyo ezingezantsi. (i yiyunithi engeyonyani kwaye i²=−1.)

z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga enye enye ukuba ifaktha nganye iyahlula ngakumbi ngamakoyefishenti kuloo luhlu na.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.a: Ukuba amakoyefishenti anqunyelwe kumanani apheleleyo, isisombululo ① asinakwahlulwa ngakumbi
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.a: Uyazi ukuba "isiphelo" simiselwa luluhlu lwamakoyefishenti olusebenzisayo.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba amakoyefishenti avumelekile ukuya kumanani anyanisekileyo, isisombululo ① asikahlulwa ngokupheleleyo
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.b: Ubonile ukuba kumanani anyanisekileyo, x²−2 iyahlula ibe ngamabinzana amabini alungeleyo.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.c: x²+2 iyahlula ibe yi-(x−√2)(x+√2) kumanani anyanisekileyo
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.c: Ukwandisa (x−√2)(x+√2) kunika i-x²−2. Jonga ukuba ifana na ne-x²+2.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.d: Nokuba usebenzisa luluphi uluhlu lwamakoyefishenti, isisombululo ① siyimveliso yokugqibela yeefaktha
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.d: Zikho amabinzana anokwahlulwa ngakumbi njengoko uluhlu lwamakoyefishenti lukhula.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.e: Ukuba amanani apheleleyo avumelekile, x²+2 nayo iyahlula ibe yimveliso yamabinzana amabini alungeleyo
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.e: Ubonile ukuba izisombululo ze-x²+2=0 azizo ezinyanisekileyo, ngoko kumanani apheleleyo iyahlula ibe ngamabinzana alungeleyo.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.explain: "Isiphelo" sokwenza iifaktha sixhomekeke kuluhlu lwamakoyefishenti. Kumanani apheleleyo yi-(x²−2)(x²+2), kumanani anyanisekileyo yi-(x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), kwaye kumanani apheleleyo yimveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo. x²+2 ayihluli ngakumbi kumanani anyanisekileyo, kwaye (x−√2)(x+√2)=x²−2.
